style: the bathing hall of an old Tokyo public bathhouse (a sento) from the 1950s, empty, clean and well kept: small square glazed tiles everywhere, white on the walls up to shoulder height with a band of cobalt blue along the top, pale blue-grey mosaic tiles on the floor with dark grout, cobalt blue tiles round the baths; pale mint-green painted plaster above the tiles, a little water-stained; a dark timber plank ceiling with a white-painted glazed lantern; over the baths a wall-wide hand-painted mural of Mount Fuji above a blue lake with pine trees, in flat enamel colours; clear, still bath water; chrome taps, small mirrors, yellow plastic bowls and stools
floorStyle: a bathhouse floor of small square mosaic tiles: pale blue-grey, with dark grout, wet

setting.place: the old public bathhouses of Tokyo, the real places this scene is built after
setting.carriers: Walls, bath rims, columns and partitions
setting.details: tile joints, a band of coloured tiles, small drain grates and faint water stains
setting.materials: glazed tiles, painted plaster, timber or glass
setting.fill: carrying on its tiles and joints at the same size, with nothing new set against it
setting.light: soft, even daylight from the lantern overhead, with no cast shadows and no sunlit patches
